This trend is not unique to TTEC, as many business process outsourcing (BPO) companies have seen significant stock drops since the end of the COVID-19 pandemic, attributed by some analysts to a "reversion to the mean." TTEC is focusing on offshoring and using AI to improve employee performance rather than replace human workers, while facing challenges from foreign-exchange pressures and client hesitancy due to AI uncertainty.

Title: Cognizant Recognized as One of America's Best Employers for Veterans by Forbes
Summary: Cognizant has been recognized on Forbes' list of America's Best Employers for Veterans 2025, an award presented in collaboration with Statista. This recognition highlights Cognizant's commitment to supporting veterans through its Veterans Network and partnerships like Code Platoon, which provides technical training and career placement for service members and military spouses. The company emphasizes the unique skills and leadership veterans bring to the workforce.

Title: EPAM Systems Raises Forecast As AI Spend Drives Growth
Summary: EPAM Systems has raised its annual forecast for the third time this year, driven by strong demand for AI, cloud, and automation services. The IT consultancy’s third-quarter revenue and adjusted earnings surpassed analyst expectations, leading to a 4% pop in its shares. This reflects a broader trend of increased tech spending and digital transformation across industries, with companies like Cognizant also raising their outlooks.

Title: Gartner: How CIOs can lead the talent remix
Summary: This article by Gartner discusses how CIOs can lead the "talent remix" amidst AI integration, emphasizing that AI-driven layoffs are often misunderstood. It outlines three AI layoff strategies—Repositioning fulltime employees, Restraining hires, and Reducing Headcount—and provides a framework for CIOs to strategically manage talent alongside AI implementation, moving from pressure to analytical precision.

Title: EPAM Systems, Inc. (NYSE:EPAM) Just Released Its Third-Quarter Earnings: Here's What Analysts Think
Summary: EPAM Systems (NYSE:EPAM) saw a 7.2% share rise after reporting third-quarter earnings. While revenues met forecasts at US$1.4b, statutory EPS of US$1.91 fell slightly below expectations. Analysts are now predicting US$5.82b in revenues for 2026 and a 30% increase in EPS to US$8.69, suggesting a more bullish sentiment, though the consensus price target remains unchanged at US$207.

Title: Salesforce to expand investments, operations in India, says Parameswaran
Summary: Salesforce plans to significantly expand its investments and operations in India, citing the country's rich talent pool. Salesforce, which began operations in India in 2005, now has over 13,000 employees and expects global revenues to exceed $41 billion by FY26. The company sees major growth opportunities in sectors like BFSI, retail, manufacturing, and foresees increasing AI adoption in India.

Title: Market Participants Recognise EPAM Systems, Inc.'s (NYSE:EPAM) Earnings Pushing Shares 28% Higher
Summary: EPAM Systems Inc. (NYSE:EPAM) shares have surged 28% in the past month, despite still being down 25% over the last year. The company's P/E ratio of 27.1x is higher than the market average, driven by analyst expectations of 17% annual earnings growth over the next three years, significantly outpacing the market's projected 11%. This strong earnings outlook is contributing to its high P/E ratio, suggesting shareholders anticipate a prosperous future.

Title: Maxim Group Remains a Buy on Castellum (CTM)
Summary: Maxim Group analyst Allen Klee has reiterated a Buy rating on Castellum (CTM), despite an average return of -10.2% and a 32.66% success rate on recommended stocks according to TipRanks. Corporate insider sentiment for CTM is currently negative, with several insiders, including GC JAY O WRIGHT, having sold shares recently. The company has also secured a major $66.2 million contract award and expanded its IT services.

Title: The Next Wave Of AI Winners? Investors Shift Focus Beyond Nvidia
Summary: Goldman Sachs suggests that the AI trade is moving into a new phase where investors are looking beyond AI infrastructure builders like Nvidia, towards companies that are effectively utilizing AI to achieve productivity gains. Despite widespread AI mentions in Q3 earnings, few companies have quantified revenue or earnings impact, leading investors to seek "AI productivity beneficiaries" that exhibit high labor intensity and exposure to automation. Goldman identifies several firms in finance, consulting, software, and HR services that could be the next AI winners, emphasizing that their value creation comes from wise AI application rather than AI building.

Title: [Form 4] COGNIZANT TECHNOLOGY SOLUTIONS CORP Insider Trading Activity
Summary: A Form 4 SEC filing by Cognizant Technology Solutions (CTSH) details insider trading activity for Surya Gummadi, President - Americas, involving the acquisition of Class A common stock through vesting restricted stock units (RSUs). Title: Rackspace Technology Announces New Appointments of Lata Varghese and Phani Kishore Burre to Strengthen Business Transformation and Services Delivery in Public Cloud
Summary: Rackspace Technology has appointed Lata Varghese as Senior Vice President of Business Transformation and Phani Kishore Burre as Senior Vice President of Services and Delivery for its Public Cloud unit. These strategic hires aim to enhance Rackspace's operational model and focus on delivering practical AI and hybrid cloud solutions to clients. The appointments underscore Rackspace's commitment to improving service delivery and adapting to the rapid changes in technology for its customers.

Title: NTT DATA Group (OTCPK:NTDT.Y): How the ServiceNow AI Partnership Shapes Its Current Valuation
Summary: NTT DATA Group has announced an expanded strategic partnership with ServiceNow to deliver AI-powered solutions, a move seen as a significant driver for its stock performance. The company's P/E ratio of 27.4x indicates a premium valuation compared to its peers and industry average, suggesting high market expectations for future growth. Investors are faced with the dilemma of whether further upside exists or if recent gains already price in future growth given the current valuation.

Title: SUI Group (NASDAQ: SUIG) lends 2M SUI to Bluefin, securing 5% revenue share for DeFi
Summary: SUI Group (NASDAQ: SUIG) has formed a strategic partnership with Bluefin, a leading decentralized exchange on the Sui blockchain, involving a loan of 2 million SUI tokens. This collaboration aims to accelerate institutional adoption of perpetual futures and structured products in DeFi, with SUI Group receiving a 5.00% revenue share from Bluefin, payable in SUI. The partnership is designed to benefit SUIG shareholders through enhanced returns and a differentiated value stream from institutional SUI trading and liquidity.

Title: Cognizant Releases 2023 Sustainability and Corporate Citizenship Report
Summary: Cognizant released its 2023 Sustainability and Corporate Citizenship Report, highlighting significant progress in workforce preparation, responsible AI development, and sustainability efforts. The company invested $70 million in philanthropic funds since 2018, launched the Synapse skilling initiative to train one million people in AI and other tech skills, and increased women's representation in its workforce. Cognizant also achieved a 47% reduction in emissions compared to its 2019 baseline and aims for zero e-waste to landfill by 2030.

Title: Top TechnologyExecutives Recognized at the 2025 GeorgiaCIO ORBIE Awards
Summary: The 2025 GeorgiaCIO ORBIE Awards honored top technology executives for their leadership, innovation, and business impact. Award recipients from companies such as Southern Company, AGCO Corporation, and Equifax were recognized across various categories, including a Lifetime Achievement ORBIE for Martin Davis. The event, hosted by GeorgiaCIO, highlighted CIOs who drive transformational change and contribute significantly to the industry.

Title: CHOW Stock Price, Forecast & Analysis | CHOWCHOW CLOUD INTERNATIONAL (NYSEARCA:CHOW)
Summary: This article provides a detailed analysis of CHOWCHOW CLOUD INTERNATIONAL (NYSEARCA:CHOW), including its current stock price, market capitalization, and various financial metrics. Title: Mphasis Achieves Notable ESG Score from S&P Global
Summary: Mphasis Limited has received a notable Corporate Sustainability Assessment Score of 73 out of 100 from S&P Global for 2025, reflecting its strong commitment to environmental, social, and governance (ESG) practices. This score is expected to enhance its industry reputation and provide stakeholders with insights into its sustainability efforts. Mphasis specializes in IT services, cloud and cognitive services, and business process outsourcing, focusing on innovative technology solutions for digital transformation.

Title: Is Cognizant Technology Solutions Corp Gaining or Losing Market Support?
Summary: Cognizant Technology Solutions Corp's short interest has increased by 10.03% since its last report, with 29.87 million shares sold short, representing 8.12% of its float. This rise in short interest suggests a more bearish market sentiment towards the company. Compared to its peers, Cognizant has higher short interest, averaging 5.95% of the float.

Title: A Fresh Look at Cognizant (CTSH) Valuation Following New Ataccama Data Automation Launch
Summary: Cognizant (CTSH) recently partnered with Ataccama to launch ONE Bridge, an automation accelerator for data migrations, signaling its focus on modern data governance. Despite a 7.5% share price gain in the last month, its total shareholder return is down 2.7% over the past year, though it has seen a 29.8% return over three years. Analysts suggest the stock is 9.0% undervalued, with a fair value estimate of $84.70, driven by its aggressive development of AI and agentic capabilities and potential for revenue expansion and margin growth, though competitive pressures remain a challenge.

Title: COGNIZANT TECHNOLOGY SOLUTIONS CORP CLASS A - Ro Khanna Congressional Trade on Oct. 07, 2025

The transaction was a sale of shares valued between $1,001 and $15,000, traded on October 7, 2025, and disclosed on November 6, 2025. Following the trade, CTSH stock showed a 14.38% price change, significantly outperforming the SPY's 2.15% change since the trade date.

Title: Indian IT services majors emerge as key bidders for US Bancorp's GCCs
Summary: Indian IT services majors like TCS, Wipro, Cognizant, and ANSR are key bidders for a mandate from US Bancorp to establish two global capability centers (GCCs) in India. The fifth-largest US bank plans to insource a significant portion of its technology work and is looking to build centers in Hyderabad and Chennai. The Hyderabad unit is expected to be wholly owned, while the Chennai facility may operate under a build-operate-transfer model.

Title: Will IBM Cloud Powering Zyphra’s AMD-Based Frontier AI Training Change International Business Machines' (IBM) Narrative?
Summary: IBM Cloud's role in Zyphra's frontier AI training, using an AMD-based platform for ZAYA1, reinforces IBM's relevance in high-performance AI. While this collaboration highlights IBM Cloud's capabilities, it doesn't fundamentally alter IBM's near-term investment narrative which remains focused on hybrid cloud and AI software growth. The key challenge for IBM is demonstrating that these high-profile AI wins translate into significant revenue and margin contributions to support its growth thesis against existing legacy pressures and a high debt load.

Title: Amdocs Limited (DOX): A Bull Case Theory
Summary: This article summarizes a bullish thesis on Amdocs Limited (DOX) from David J. Waldron of Quality Value Investing. Amdocs, a dividend-paying mid-cap IT services company, benefits from sticky customer relationships, consistent dividend policy, and strategic share repurchases. Despite underperforming the S&P 500 in revenue growth, its strong gross margins, double-digit owners' earnings growth, and robust capital allocation make it an attractive investment.

Title: US Bancorp taps TCS, Wipro, Cognizant, ANSR for India GCC mandate
Summary: US Bancorp is actively seeking to establish two global capability centers (GCCs) in India, with TCS, Wipro, Cognizant, and ANSR emerging as key bidders for the mandate. The fifth-largest US bank plans significant insourcing of its technology operations, aiming to hire between 3,000 and 5,000 employees over the next five years, valued at approximately $250 million. This move positions US Bancorp as a late but significant entrant into India's growing GCC landscape for financial services, with plans for centers in Hyderabad and Chennai.

Title: Infosys Ltd spurts 1.75%, rises for third straight session
Summary: Infosys Ltd saw a 1.75% increase in its stock price, trading at Rs 1625.5 on the NSE, marking its third consecutive session of gains. This surge contributed to a 10.83% rise over the last month for Infosys, outperforming the Nifty IT index, which gained 10.07% in the same period. Despite these recent gains, the stock is still down 15.44% over the past year.

Title: IBM (NYSE: IBM) helps Riyadh Air build world's first AI-native airline, unifying ops and CX
Summary: Riyadh Air and IBM have partnered to create the world's first AI-native airline, embedding AI across operations, employee tools, and customer care. This three-year collaboration, utilizing IBM watsonx Orchestrate and IBM Consulting Advantage, aims to transform guest and employee experiences ahead of initial commercial service in early 2026. Riyadh Air plans to significantly expand its workforce and connectivity to over 100 destinations by 2030, leveraging AI to drive efficiency and innovation.

Title: Infosys Limited (INFY) Secures Overweight Ratings Amid Strong Bookings and Cybersecurity Growth
Summary: Infosys Limited (INFY) has received reiterated Overweight ratings from JPMorgan and Jefferies due to strong bookings, stable demand, and its artificial intelligence proposition, particularly in cybersecurity. Despite general IT sector strain, Infosys secured $6.9 billion in bookings during the first half of its fiscal year, with an additional $1.6 billion from NHDS contracts. The company is recognized for its end-to-end cybersecurity services using AI-powered approaches for global enterprises.

Title: Amdocs (NASDAQ: DOX) picked by e& UAE to deploy telco GenAI platform amAIz with NVIDIA
Summary: Amdocs (NASDAQ: DOX) has been selected by e& UAE to deploy its amAIz generative AI platform, integrating GenAI across its telco systems with NVIDIA AI Enterprise tooling. This partnership aims to enhance customer care, retail, and network operations by improving efficiency, accelerating resolutions, and generating new revenue opportunities, all while ensuring secure and scalable GenAI deployment. The initiative represents a significant step towards AI-driven transformation in the telecommunications industry.

Title: AI isn’t the reason you got laid off (or not hired), top staffing agency says. You don’t have the right skills
Summary: According to ManpowerGroup, a leading staffing agency, AI is not the primary cause of job losses; rather, skill mismatches, weak demand, and economic headwinds are more significant factors. While automation reshapes job descriptions, workers lacking the right technical and human skills are most vulnerable. Employers report difficulty finding skilled talent, especially in AI-related areas, indicating a talent shortage rather than a lack of work, and are focusing on upskilling their existing workforce to bridge this gap.

Title: Microsoft, Cognizant and Intel Chiefs meet PM Modi in efforts to boost AI adoption in India — Here's what we know
Summary: The CEOs of Microsoft, Cognizant, and Intel met individually with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi on December 9, 2025, to discuss accelerating AI adoption in India. Microsoft announced a significant $17.5 billion investment to boost AI infrastructure and skills in the country, while Cognizant and Intel also reaffirmed their commitment to India's technological advancement. These meetings highlight India's growing importance as a hub for AI development and investment, with total Big Tech AI-centric data center investment plans reaching $42.5 billion in 2025.

Title: ISG (Nasdaq: III) 2025 report shows insurers building GCCs to access AI talent, cut costs
Summary: A new 2025 report by Information Services Group (ISG) indicates that insurance carriers are increasingly establishing Global Capability Centers (GCCs) in partnership with service providers. This strategy aims to attract AI talent, reduce operational costs, enhance capabilities, and improve resilience amidst market changes and economic uncertainties. The report highlights various GCC implementation models that help insurers address challenges like inflation and skill shortages, particularly in AI, by leveraging offshore expertise and enabling quicker modernization.

Title: Cognizant Unveils Artificial Intelligence Lab and Cognizant Moment™ Studio in Bengaluru
Summary: Cognizant has launched an Artificial Intelligence Lab and a Cognizant Moment™ Studio in Bengaluru, India, as part of its $1 billion generative AI investment strategy. This innovation hub aims to advance AI builder capabilities, focusing on developing multi-agent systems, AI decisioning, responsible AI, and AI-for-good initiatives. The new facilities will combine AI research with user experience design to accelerate enterprise transformation and create intelligent, human-centered digital experiences for clients.

Title: Microsoft ties up with TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant to accelerate Agentic AI in India | Business News
Summary: Microsoft Corp. has partnered with Tata Consultancy Services Ltd., Infosys Ltd., Wipro Ltd., and Cognizant Technology Solutions Corp. to advance the adoption of Agentic AI in India. This collaboration involves deploying over 50,000 Microsoft Copilot licenses by each IT company, marking a significant step in enterprise-scale AI adoption. Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella expressed excitement about the momentum in India and the company's planned $17.5-billion investment in the country.

Title: Microsoft partners with TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant to scale AI adoption in India
Summary: Microsoft has partnered with four major Indian IT companies—TCS, Infosys, Wipro, and Cognizant—to accelerate AI adoption, deploying over 200,000 Microsoft Copilot licenses collectively. This initiative aims to transform workflows across various functions and signifies a significant investment by Microsoft in India's cloud and AI infrastructure. The collaboration is intended to help these firms enable global enterprises to lead in the AI-driven economy by integrating AI into their core operations.

Title: Microsoft Names Cognizant, Infosys, TCS, Wipro as “Frontier Firms” for Copilot Deployment
Summary: Microsoft has designated Cognizant, Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), and Wipro as “frontier firms” for their significant roles in deploying Copilot and agentic AI across enterprise operations. These Indian IT majors are collectively deploying over 200,000 Microsoft Copilot licenses, deepening their partnership with Microsoft as the company expands its AI infrastructure investments in India. The collaborations aim to transform workflows, enhance productivity, and accelerate AI-powered innovation across various industries.

Title: Microsoft, TCS, Infosys, Wipro Partner for Massive AI Adoption
Summary: Microsoft has partnered with major Indian IT service providers TCS, Cognizant, Wipro, and Infosys to significantly expand AI adoption through its Copilot tool. Each company plans to deploy over 50,000 Microsoft Copilot licenses, collectively exceeding 200,000 licenses. This initiative, highlighted by Satya Nadella, sets a new benchmark for enterprise-scale AI integration.

Title: Insurers Adopt GCCs to Address AI Needs, Strengthen Operations
Summary: Insurance enterprises are increasingly partnering with service providers to establish global capability centers (GCCs) to attract AI resources, reduce costs, expand capabilities, and improve operational resilience. This strategy addresses the insurance industry's AI needs and talent shortages, as many insurers lack the internal technology resources to implement AI while managing legacy systems. GCC models, offered by providers, allow for quicker access to skilled talent and accelerate modernization initiatives, including AI, cloud migration, and automation.

Title: Cognizant, Infosys, TCS and Wipro are partnering with Microsoft to deploy Copilot and agentic AI
Summary: Microsoft has announced strategic partnerships with Cognizant, Infosys, TCS, and Wipro to accelerate the adoption of agentic AI. These four leading IT companies will collectively deploy over 200,000 Microsoft Copilot licenses, signaling a significant move towards enterprise-scale AI integration. This initiative aims to enhance productivity, efficiency, and accessibility while driving AI-powered innovation across various industries, following Microsoft's plan to invest US$17.5 billion in cloud and AI infrastructure in India.

Title: IBM (NYSE: IBM) and Pearson to develop AI learning tools for global workforce upskilling
Summary: IBM and Pearson have announced a global partnership to create AI-powered personalized learning tools for businesses, organizations, and educational institutions, aiming to address critical skills mismatches. The collaboration will leverage IBM's watsonx technologies and integrate Pearson's enterprise learning solutions, including Credly, Faethm, and Pearson Professional Assessments. This initiative will also provide Pearson's learning solutions to IBM's 270,000 employees and customers, helping people globally adapt and thrive in an evolving AI-driven workforce.

Title: Cognizant Technology Solutions Corporation $CTSH Shares Acquired by State Street Corp
Summary: State Street Corp increased its stake in Cognizant Technology Solutions (NASDAQ:CTSH) by 0.6% in the second quarter, now owning 5.20% of the company valued at $1.98 billion. Despite recent insider selling, analysts maintain a "Hold" rating with a consensus price target of $85.44, and the company pays a quarterly dividend.

Title: BayWa and Cognizant Agree on Strategic IT Partnership
Summary: Cognizant and German multi-sector trading company BayWa have initiated a five-year strategic IT partnership focused on digital transformation and IT service operations. Cognizant will manage core IT services and BayWa employees, aiming to create a scalable IT landscape and boost innovation. The collaboration encompasses IT infrastructure, application management, service desk, and workplace services, with plans to integrate modern technologies like AI and automation.

Title: How Investors May Respond To Cognizant (CTSH) Expanding AI Fleet Management Capabilities With Merchants Fleet Partnership
Summary: Cognizant (CTSH) recently partnered with Merchants Fleet to enhance fleet management through AI-powered automation and predictive analytics, aiming to address industry challenges. This collaboration reinforces Cognizant's position in enterprise AI and its commitment to digital transformation. While the deal aligns with Cognizant's long-term strategy, investors should also consider potential risks such as increased competition from cloud and AI platforms.

Title: A Look Into Cognizant Tech Solns Inc's Price Over Earnings
Summary: Cognizant Tech Solns Inc. (NASDAQ: CTSH) saw a 0.25% drop in share price, currently at $80.51, following a month of gains but a yearly decline. Title: Wix Teams Up With Stripe to Deliver Agentic Commerce Suite to Merchants
Summary: Wix.com Ltd. (WIX) has announced a new integration with Stripe’s Agentic Commerce Suite, enabling its merchants to sell across various AI agents seamlessly. This collaboration aims to simplify AI-driven commerce for businesses by providing a unified, low-code solution through Stripe's Agentic Storefront. This move follows previous partnerships with PayPal in 2025 to enhance AI-driven product discovery and payment solutions, reinforcing Wix's commitment to adapting to the evolving e-commerce landscape and AI innovations.

Title: Wix Teams Up With Stripe to Deliver Agentic Commerce Suite to Merchants
Summary: Wix.com Ltd. (WIX) has announced an integration with Stripe’s Agentic Commerce Suite, allowing its merchants to sell across multiple AI agents seamlessly and addressing the complexities of fragmented AI platforms. This partnership aims to enhance capabilities in AI-powered shopping and follows previous collaborations with PayPal Inc. (PYPL) to boost AI-driven product discovery and payment solutions. Wix anticipates continued revenue growth for 2025, driven by strategic partnerships and a strong position in the e-commerce market.

Title: AI boosts customer service jobs, not cuts: Gartner survey
Summary: A Gartner survey reveals that AI is augmenting customer service roles rather than replacing them, with only 20% of organizations reducing headcount due to AI. The study found that 55% of firms maintain stable staffing while handling increased customer volumes, using AI to boost efficiency and optimize workflows. AI is also creating new specialized positions like AI strategists and conversational AI designers, suggesting a catalyst for workforce evolution in customer service and outsourcing.

Title: Accelerating the AI-Powered Future: Wipro & Microsoft to Empower Enterprises to Transform as Frontier Firms
Summary: Wipro Limited and Microsoft have announced a three-year strategic partnership to help enterprises become "Frontier Firms" by accelerating AI adoption. This collaboration combines Wipro's consulting and engineering expertise with Microsoft's cloud and AI platforms to develop industry-specific solutions and empower businesses with AI-powered workflows. A new Microsoft Innovation Hub at Wipro's Partner Labs in Bengaluru will drive co-innovation and deliver scalable AI solutions.

Title: Infosys Sees Heavy Call Option Activity as Market Eyes December Expiry

Summary: Cognizant Technology Solutions has opened an India AI Lab and Moment Studio in Bengaluru, investing US$1 billion in generative AI, focusing on multi-agent systems, AI decisioning, responsible AI, and immersive enterprise experiences. Title: AI Isn’t an Economic Moat Killer, But It Will Disrupt Industries
